name: Kevin Saunderson
hook: The third Belleville Three member, whose Inner City records were the ones that actually charted.
blurb: The youngest of the Belleville Three, Saunderson founded KMS Records in 1987 after watching Juan Atkins and Derrick May run their own labels. He is the one most linked with techno crossing over into commercial dance-pop. His group Inner City, with singer Paris Grey, turned techno's machine sound into a pop hit with "Big Fun" in 1988, which reached the UK top ten. It was first pressed on KMS and then licensed to a Virgin subsidiary for the compilation "Techno! The New Dance Sound of Detroit", one of the records that carried the word "techno" itself into wide use as the name of a genre.

signatureTracks.title: Big Fun (Inner City)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Techno's clearest pop crossover to that point: a full vocal hook over a 909 groove, first pressed on Saunderson's own KMS.

signatureTracks.title: Good Life (Inner City)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Inner City's second hit the same year, confirming Big Fun wasn't a one-off.
